# LAMEJS bundled encoder

The separate `lamejs.js` distribution is from `@breezystack/lamejs` version
1.2.7. Its package metadata declares LGPL-3.0. The package's upstream license
notice is retained in `UPSTREAM-LICENSE-NOTICE.txt`; the complete LGPL text is
in `LGPL-3.0.txt`.

The encoder is loaded as a separate ES module by `src/export-worker.js` and can
be replaced independently. Upstream project: https://github.com/shijinyu/lamejs
and LAME acknowledgement: https://lame.sourceforge.net/.
